## What's Changed

* feat: add analyze command by @rmarescu in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/402

* feat: improve init experience by @rmarescu in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/412
* feat: add generate command by @rmarescu in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/410
* feat: add sample test file generation to init command by @rmarescu in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/411

* Update README text from 'Anthropic API key will default to' to 'The Anthropic API key defaults to' by @devin-ai-integration in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/415
* chore: Move json.test.ts from tests/unit/ai/utils to src/ai/utils by @devin-ai-integration in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/417
* chore: add get-git-info.test.ts by @rmarescu in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/416
* chore: add unit tests for createHash utility by @devin-ai-integration in https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/pull/418


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/antiwork/shortest/compare/v0.4.8...v0.4.9
